integrity: The complete theorem follows from the proved two-round EF profile criterion and uniform arithmetic case analysis; computer checks only support finite instances.
scientific_limitations: Only finite cyclic groups with equality, a named identity, and a ternary relational addition symbol are covered, not functional-addition first-order theories.
The sharp size-24 bound is relative to cyclic representatives, not arbitrary structures.
Finite computations corroborate but do not replace the all-orders atomic-profile argument.
Possible equivalent coverage in unindexed historical sources cannot be ruled out; independent review is unperformed.
title: Fifteen two-round theories of finite cyclic groups, with a sharp 24-element kernel
